dogecoin.text: @EdmonYousif1 @itsALLrisky @elonmusk I don't think we need Elon to do anything. Dogecoin has been a solid investment from the start. Even those left holding the bag back in 2017/2018 are doing just fine now. Same will be said about this time. The only losers will be the panic sellers selling at a loss, as always.

@MKordafshari @itsALLrisky It is capped by the number of Dogecoin that can be created in one year. It will take 25 years for the supply of Dogecoin to double. While in the meantime, 40% of all USD in existence was created just in the last year. Do the math. Now which is more inflationary?

@gabbinggeek @dogecoin_devs "no cap"... Is such a tired, ignorant and lazy argument against DOGE.  It will take 25 years for the supply of DOGE to double. Meanwhile 40% of all USD currently in circulation were created in the last 2 years. Given that, I think I would rather hold DOGE than dollars.
